findings.recommendation: 공유 데이터인지 먼저 확인하고, 사용자 전용 데이터라면 해당 작업의 기존 행 조건(USING)과 새 행 조건(WITH CHECK)에 실제 소유자 컬럼과 auth.uid() 비교를 적용하세요. 여러 permissive 정책과 GRANT도 함께 검토하세요.
verificationSteps: 격리 테스트 환경에서 사용자 A·B의 조회·수정·삭제와 소유자 변경을 각각 확인하세요.
익명 사용자와 관리자 경로를 따로 검사하고 실제 적용 migration·GRANT·역할을 대조한 뒤 재검사하세요.

manualPaths.declaredIntent: Public todo CRUD; absence of login is not a vulnerability label.
policyLimits: No explicit GRANT in collected declaration

manualPaths.manualFlow: POST request.text to third-party signature check, switch and mutation helpers
limitations: Signature-check success and HTTP-to-helper mutation payload not automatically proven
Root database.sql was collected but UNSUPPORTED/NO_SUPPORTED_ANALYZER
Payment webhook structure is not a user ownership truth label

manualPaths.firstRegistrationBarrier: Exported authActionClient.schema(...).action(callback) wrapper is not a supported Next request registration

relatedBarriers.reason: External middleware and auth helper semantics unverified

policyLimits: Custom trigger and migration ordering require context
No vulnerability or authorization success is confirmed

excludedCandidates.reason: Public API returned 404; no bypass or source intake

failureCasePack.fix: Bounded earlier local const environment-absence throw accepted in factory provenance; not an authentication guard.
failureCasePack.regression: guarded-client-factory.test.mjs; route/server-function Grade B controls; existing app and policy replays
unresolved: Automatic write payload and auth identity linkage
Custom wrappers and incomplete SQL context
Actual operating roles, grants and policy installation

limitations: Final policy warnings and connected policy evidence are separate metrics; this is not a measured increase in real vulnerability recall.
FormData/request input to mutation arguments is manually reviewed in controls and public paths, not new automatic write-argument taint analysis.
Next request declarations are not evidence of deployed invocation. Auth calls/results are not actual JWT validation or authorization.
PostgreSQL validates authored policy semantics only, using a current_setting-based auth.uid stub, not external migrations or Supabase Auth.
Grade C apps have no whole-project SAFE/TN label; all observed sources become regression material.
Source-backed controls are same-author Grade B, not independent human review or a blind holdout.
Worker resource replay uses parsed source/completed SQL subsets and is not whole-backend RSS or complete policy execution.
Live GitHub App, real Supabase, actual AI Provider and public deployment were not tested.
